transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a situation today where the portable powered bariatric lift has been requested by both the medical unit and the surgical recovery unit. Since we only have one lift available, I need to make a deployment decision. Per our policy, I'd like to hold our routine check-in with physical therapy and biomedical equipment to review the requests and any operational details before I finalize the deployment plan. Could the representatives from physical therapy and biomedical equipment please share their input?

transcript.text: I need to share important information about the medical unit's request. The medical unit's patient requires the powered bariatric lift for every transfer from 10:00 AM through 6:00 PM today. The standard floor lift cannot safely support this patient's transfer plan. I completed the assessment this morning before the request was entered.

transcript.text: I have an important update regarding the surgical recovery unit's lift situation. I verified with the repair technician that their currently unavailable lift has a confirmed biomedical repair completion time of 2:00 PM today, after which it can be used for that unit's transfers.
